yaml:
scenario: qSOFA_Sepsis_Screen
version: 1.0.0
description: Screen for sepsis using qSOFA criteria
signals:
  RR:
    ref: respiratory_rate
    expected_unit: bpm
    description: Respiratory rate
    concept_id: 3024171
    concept_code: 9279-1
    vocabulary_id: LOINC
  SBP:
    ref: systolic_blood_pressure
    expected_unit: mmHg
    description: Systolic blood pressure
    concept_id: 3004249
    concept_code: 8480-6
    vocabulary_id: LOINC
  GCS:
    ref: glasgow_coma_scale
    expected_unit: score
    description: Glasgow Coma Scale score
    concept_id: 3032652
    concept_code: 35088-4
    vocabulary_id: LOINC
trends:
  rr_current:
    expr: last(RR)
    description: Current respiratory rate
  sbp_current:
    expr: last(SBP)
    description: Current systolic blood pressure
  gcs_current:
    expr: last(GCS)
    description: Current Glasgow Coma Scale score
logic:
  high_rr:
    when: rr_current >= 22
    severity: low
    description: Respiratory rate of 22 or more
  low_sbp:
    when: sbp_current <= 100
    severity: low
    description: Systolic blood pressure of 100 mmHg or less
  low_gcs:
    when: gcs_current < 15
    severity: low
    description: Glasgow Coma Scale score below 15
  sepsis_risk:
    when: (high_rr + low_sbp + low_gcs) >= 2
    severity: high
    description: Patient at high risk for sepsis based on qSOFA criteria
outputs:
  decision:
    high_sepsis_risk:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.sepsis_risk
      description: Patient is at high risk for sepsis
  features:
    respiratory_rate:
      type: float
      from: trends.rr_current
      description: Current respiratory rate
    systolic_blood_pressure:
      type: float
      from: trends.sbp_current
      description: Current systolic blood pressure
    gcs_score:
      type: float
      from: trends.gcs_current
      description: Current Glasgow Coma Scale score
  evidence:
    timestamp:
      type: datetime
      expr: evaluation_time()
      description: When this evaluation was performed
